{{Infobox Item |version1 = Normal |version2 = Locked |version3 = Locked and broken |version4 = Locked and mangled |name1 = Ancient sceptre |name2 = Ancient sceptre (l) |name3 = Ancient sceptre (l) (broken) |name4 = Ancient sceptre (l) (mangled) |image1 = [[File:Ancient sceptre.png]] |image2 = [[File:Ancient sceptre (l).png]] |image3 = [[File:Ancient sceptre (l) (broken).png]] |image4 = [[File:Ancient sceptre (l) (mangled).png]] |release1 = [[11 January]] [[2023]] |release2 = [[11 January]] [[2023]] |release3 = [[8 July]] [[2026]] |release4 = [[8 July]] [[2026]] |update1 = Secrets of the North & More! |update2 = Secrets of the North & More! |update3 = The Blood Moon Rises Tweaks & Fixes |update4 = The Blood Moon Rises Tweaks & Fixes |members = Yes |quest = No |tradeable = No |equipable1 = Yes |equipable2 = Yes |equipable3 = No |equipable4 = No |stackable = No |noteable = No |options1 = Wield, Drop |options2 = Wield, Drop |options3 = Drop |options4 = Drop |examine1 = A very old and powerful stick. |examine2 = A very old and powerful stick. |examine3 = A very old and powerful stick. |examine4 = A very old and powerful stick. |value = 211000 |alchable = No |weight = 2.267 |id1 = 27624 |id2 = 27626 |id3 = 33827 |id4 = 33829 |leagueRegion = Fremennik }} {{Synced switch |version1 = [[File:Ancient sceptre detail.png|left|150px]] |version2 = [[File:Ancient sceptre (l) detail.png|left|150px]] |version3 = [[File:Ancient sceptre (l) (broken) detail.png|left|150px]] |version4 = [[File:Ancient sceptre (l) (mangled) detail.png|left|150px]] }} The '''ancient sceptre''' is an upgraded version of the [[Ancient staff]] that requires level 70 [[Magic]], 60 [[Strength]], 50 [[Attack]], as well as completion of [[Secrets of the North]] to wield. It is made by bringing the untradeable [[Ancient icon]] and staff to [[Eblis]]. This combination process is irreversible. The ancient sceptre, like its predecessor, can be used to [[autocast]] spells from the [[Ancient Magicks]] and [[standard spellbook]]. Unlike the ancient staff, the ancient sceptre provides a 10% Magic damage bonus, as well as a [[passive effect]] that increases [[Ancient Magicks#Combat spells|the effects]] of Ancient Magicks by 10%. This passive effect does not increase the Magic damage bonus. As a [[Zaros#Affiliated_items|Zarosian item]], it will also grant [[god protection]] towards Zarosian NPCs in the [[God Wars Dungeon]]. If the player dies a PvP death and the item is unprotected, it is reverted to an ancient staff that is dropped for the killer, and the ancient icon disappears. To prevent this, a [[Trouver parchment]] and a payment of {{NoCoins|500,000}} coins can be given to [[Perdu]] in order to permanently [[(l)|lock]] the item. The locked item will remain in the player's inventory; however, the item will be in a mangled, unusable state and must be repaired by using it on Perdu and paying him {{NoCoins|500,000}} coins. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |version1 = Normal |version2 = Locked |astab = 20 |aslash = -1 |acrush = 50 |amagic = 20 |arange = 0 |dstab = 2 |dslash = 3 |dcrush = 1 |dmagic = 15 |drange = 0 |str = 60 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 10 |prayer = -1 |slot = weapon |speed = 4 |attackrange = staff |combatstyle = Staff |image = [[File:Ancient sceptre equipped male.png|175px]] |altimage = [[File:Ancient sceptre equipped female.png|165px]] }} {{CombatStyles|Staff|speed=4|attackrange=staff}} {{Autocasting|standard=yes|arceuus=no|ancient=yes}} ==Passive effect== The ancient sceptre has a passive effect which increases the effects of all Ancient Magicks by 10%: {| class="wikitable align-center-1" style="text-align:left; width:600px;" ! colspan="2" |Spell !Buffed effect |- |{{plinkt|Smoke Rush}} |rowspan="2" |[[Poison severity]] is increased to 11, up from 10. (Poison caused by these spells starts with 1 hit of 3 damage, instead of starting at 2 damage.) |- |{{plinkt|Smoke Burst}} |- |{{plinkt|Smoke Blitz}} |rowspan="2" |[[Poison severity]] is increased to 22, up from 20. (Poison caused by these spells starts with 2 hits of 5 damage, instead of starting at 4 damage.) |- |{{plinkt|Smoke Barrage}} |- |{{plinkt|Shadow Rush}} |rowspan="2" |Opponent's [[Attack]] level is reduced by 11% instead of 10%. |- |{{plinkt|Shadow Burst}} |- |{{plinkt|Shadow Blitz}} |rowspan="2" |Opponent's [[Attack]] level is reduced by 16.5% instead of 15%. |- |{{plinkt|Shadow Barrage}} |- |{{plinkt|Blood Rush}} |rowspan="4" |Successful hits heal the caster by 27.5% of the damage dealt instead of 25%.{{efn|This stacks multiplicatively with [[bloodbark armour]]; when worn alongside the ancient sceptre, successful hits heal the caster by 38.5% of the damage dealt.}} |- |{{plinkt|Blood Burst}} |- |{{plinkt|Blood Blitz}} |- |{{plinkt|Blood Barrage}} |- |{{plinkt|Ice Rush}} |''Ice Rush receives no buff from using the sceptre.''{{efn|A 10% increase to Ice Rush's freeze duration is 8.8 ticks. As most calculations almost always round down due to the game's engine, this effectively results in no buffs for Ice Rush.}} |- |{{plinkt|Ice Burst}} |Opponent is frozen for 17 [[ticks]] (10.2 seconds) instead of 16 ticks (9.6 seconds). |- |{{plinkt|Ice Blitz}} |Opponent is frozen for 26 ticks (15.6 seconds) instead of 24 ticks (14.4 seconds). |- |{{plinkt|Ice Barrage}} |Opponent is frozen for 35 ticks (21 seconds) instead of 32 ticks (19.2 seconds). |} {{notelist}} ==Creation== {{Recipe |notes = {{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Secrets of the North]] |members = Yes |ticks = |facilities = Eblis |mat1 = Ancient staff |mat2 = Ancient icon |mat2cost = No |output1 = Ancient sceptre |output1cost = No }} ==Quartz upgrades== The ancient sceptre can be enhanced with quartzes dropped by various bosses from [[Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire|Desert Treasure II]].{{PlainCiteNews|url=https://secure.runescape.com/m=news/a=97/desert-treasure-ii---the-fallen-empire?oldschool=1|title=Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire|newsdate=27 July 2023}} This process '''can''' be reversed. The enhanced sceptres require 75 [[Magic]], 60 [[Strength]], and 50 [[Attack]] to wield. {| class="wikitable" ! Sceptre ! Quartz ! Dropped by ! present |} ==Gallery== Ancient sceptre concept art.jpg|Concept art of the ancient sceptre by [[Mod Jerv]]. ==Trivia== * When pitched in [[Update:A Mysterious Quest: Boss Rewards|the poll blog]], the item's name was "Soulblight sceptre". This was because the name of the quest and its rewards were polled by the development team as a "Mysterious Quest", where they wished to keep the Zarosian nature of the rewards a secret. ** The true name of the quest and its rewards from the boss were then revealed in the [[Winter Summit 2022]] a month later. *It is currently one of six items with a negative [[Prayer items|prayer bonus]] (required for a master clue step), with the other items being its four upgraded versions and the [[ancient staff]] used to create it. ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Phantom Muspah}} {{Magic weapons}} {{Upgraded equipment}} [[Category:Lockable items]] [[Category:Upgraded equipment]]
